purpose: Collection coverage audit and acquisition triage for the user-supplied 48-artist roster; this is not a fame ranking.

method.public_rule: A catalog record is public when !work.hidden, matching src/lib/catalog.ts at the snapshot commit.
method.artist_matching: Unicode accent-insensitive artist-credit matching with explicit aliases and full names where surname collisions exist. Titles, search text and notes do not independently establish an artist match.
method.count_unit: Catalog records, including records after artists, casts, replicas, attributed works and interventions where the artist credit explicitly names the requested artist. This audit does not claim a deduplicated composition count or surviving-original count.
exclusions: Michelangelo and Auguste Rodin are excluded at user direction.
Unrelated surname matches are excluded, including Alexander Stirling Calder, Charles Carpeaux, Jaume/Pere Serra, and Sampson/Ismael/Josh Smith.

priority.rule: Fewest public catalog records first; original roster order breaks ties. Hidden records do not provide public coverage.
